# Pantheon Rome

> > Official visitor guide to the Pantheon in Rome, providing tickets, tours, historical information, and practical visitor details for one of ancient Rome's most iconic monuments.

PantheonRome.org serves as a comprehensive multilingual resource for visitors planning to explore the Pantheon, covering Emperor Hadrian's architectural masterpiece, Agrippa's original temple, the famous dome and oculus, notable tombs including Raphael's, and practical information about tickets, opening hours, and guided tours in Piazza della Rotonda.

## Key Topics

- Pantheon Rome
- Piazza della Rotonda
- Emperor Hadrian
- Marcus Agrippa
- Raphael's Tomb
- Pantheon Dome and Oculus
- Skip-the-line tickets
- Guided tours
- Rome tourism
- Ancient Roman architecture
- Visitor information
- Opening hours
- Tiqets booking platform

## Visitor Essentials

- [البانثيون في روما – معلومات الزوار الرسمية، التاريخ والتذاكر](https://pantheonrome.org/ar): Pantheon Rome homepage: visitor info, dome, oculus, tickets, and tours
- [Panteão de Roma – Informações oficiais para visitantes, história e bilhetes](https://pantheonrome.org/pt): Pantheon Rome homepage: visitor info, dome, history, and tickets
- [Billets Panthéon – Visites, Guides & Informations Pratiques](https://pantheonrome.org/fr/tickets): Pantheon tickets, guided tours, skip-the-line access, and visit info
- [Bilhetes Panteão – Visitas, Tours Guiados & Informação](https://pantheonrome.org/pt/tickets): Pantheon tickets, guided tours, skip-the-line, and audioguide options
- [万神殿开放时间 – 参观时间与季节性安排](https://pantheonrome.org/zh/visiting-hours): Pantheon opening hours, closures, and best visiting times

## Visitor Support & FAQs

- [Часто задаваемые вопросы – Билеты, Часы работы и Доступ](https://pantheonrome.org/ru/faqs): FAQ on Pantheon tickets, hours, accessibility, and photography rules
- [FAQ – Bilety, Godziny otwarcia & Dostęp](https://pantheonrome.org/pl/faqs): FAQ covering tickets, hours, accessibility, and photography at Pantheon
- [FAQ – Tiket, Jam Buka & Akses](https://pantheonrome.org/id/faqs): FAQ on Pantheon tickets, opening hours, access, and photography
